reviews.title: Invoice Generator
reviews.text: Was supposed to be free, but then once you start doing invoices, you can no longer see them unless you download another app called Soho, which is in app purchases for you to be able to see the invoices. What a waste of time would not recommend this.

reviews.title: great on iphone, not so great bon mac
reviews.text: used this app for years and its never let me down on my phone.   now i have it on my mac there isnt a sign in function so i have to add my logo and new addresses every time i also cant keeo a log of invoices between iphone and mac any chnace this will be added

reviews.title: Stupid App
reviews.text: Don’t Use. It assigns you an email address that you have no access to and the Capcha features isn’t worth trying to figure out the garbled letters and numbers.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: Take at least 30 minutes to get anything and you have to give them all your personal information. Waste of time.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: I don’t know what happened with this app but the option for CIS taxes calculated has been removed.It is really annoying because I can’t use it anymore.

reviews.title: Worst app ever! DONT EVEN BOTHER WASTING YOUR TIME
reviews.text: This app is complete junk. By far the worse app ive come across for invoice generating. Could not even complete 1 invoice in the span of 3 weeks. Nobody has time for this nonsense. If I could give -5 stars thats what this app deserves!!!!!

reviews.title: Stuck on BGN
reviews.text: Great invoice maker but now Bulgaria has changed to the Euro it will not let me change the currency so unable to use anymore. Have emailed on many occasions but no response 😕
